_comment: Illustrative power ratings, general domain knowledge only -- no cited source, see schedule.json's _comment. `climate_control_systems`, `supplemental_grow_lighting`, and `irrigation_pumps` all use `strategy_params.gate: "none"` (see core/equipment.py's `_gate_mask`) so they run on their own internal schedule regardless of whether any occupant is present -- the first use of that gate value in this package outside `hotel`'s `laundry` item (which uses the same mechanism for a different reason: batch laundry cycles that don't track guest presence hour-by-hour either). `climate_control_systems` weights are elevated overnight (frost-protection heating) and around midday (ventilation/cooling), lower in the shoulder hours -- a plausible shape, not measured. `supplemental_grow_lighting` models a common ~16h 'long-day' photoperiod (06:00-22:00), a standard horticultural lighting practice for many greenhouse crops, not a specific crop's real schedule. `irrigation_pumps` concentrates its firing probability in the morning (avoiding evening/overnight watering, standard practice to limit foliar-disease risk). `staff_area_plug_loads` mirrors `warehouse`'s own small-admin-office item.
